review_metadata_discrepancy.note: The independent review's source and test hashes match the byte-preserved v1 archive, but its claimed design hash does not match the archived design bytes. The archived bytes are retained unchanged.

v2_changes: Any hit cluster with more than one distinct parameter is unresolved independent of total span; raw hits and finite span remain recorded and the representative is diagnostic only.
Single-link chain and near-distinct short-cavity controls assert UNKNOWN and non-eligibility even when diagnostic interval midpoints are mocked IN.
Use math.hypot, finite checks, bounded midpoint/interpolation, and structured UNKNOWN numeric-range reasons; require both combined band and its doubled threshold to be finite.
Overflowing uncertainty bands avoid point-classifier calls, retain representable raw hits, and serialize with allow_nan=false.
proposed_next_check_only_after_root_revi: One bounded pytest invocation: the BondVisibilityPureMathRegressionTests class plus test_hollow_shell_endpoints_inside_but_segment_crosses_void, test_hollow_shell_preserves_all_outer_and_inner_hits, and test_same_wall_and_solid_coupon_remain_inside_material. Use the exact PowerShell command in design_and_freeze.md; no STEP export and no native integration.
